title: Document requirements for advertiser verification - Brunei - Advertising Policies Help

facts.fact: Required verification documents depend on whether the Google Ads account type is 'Organisation' or 'Individual', which can be checked in the payments profile under the Billing Settings page.
facts.quote: The documents required are based on your account type 'Organisation' or 'Individual'.

facts.fact: Organisations may need to provide two types of documentation for advertiser verification: organisation registration documents and a government-issued photo ID from an authorised representative.
facts.quote: Organisations** may be required to provide two different types of documentation for advertiser verification: organisation registration documents and a government-issued photo ID from an authorised representative.

facts.fact: Accepted organisation registration documents include a certificate of incorporation or registration, an extract from the commercial register, a business licence, and a tax certificate.
facts.quote:
Certificate of incorporation or registration
> *   Extract from commercial register
> *   Business licence
> *   Tax certificate

facts.fact: An official letter with full name, address and date is accepted as a registration document only for government departments and agencies.
facts.quote: Only for government departments and agencies: an official letter including full name, address and date

facts.fact: Accepted authorised representative photo IDs are a passport, identification card, driving licence, or permanent residence card.
facts.quote:
Passport
> *   Identification card
> *   Driving licence
> *   Permanent residence card

facts.fact: An authorised representative is an admin of the Google Ads account and/or the payments profile paying for the ads, and their government-issued photo ID can be issued in any country.
facts.quote: An authorised representative is an admin of the Google Ads account and/or the payments profile paying for the ads. The government-issued photo ID can be issued in any country.

facts.fact: Individuals must submit a Bruneian government-issued photo ID issued as part of the verification programme.
facts.quote: Individuals** must submit a Bruneian government-issued photo ID issued as part of the verification programme.

facts.fact: Accepted individual photo IDs for Brunei are a passport, national ID card, driving licence, or residence permit.
facts.quote:
Passport
> *   National ID card
> *   Driving licence
> *   Residence permit

facts.fact: In certain cases, individuals may be required to submit a second proof-of-address document matching the full name and address already submitted.
facts.quote: In certain cases, individuals may also be required to submit a second proof-of-address document matching the full name and address already submitted.

facts.fact: A utility, phone, or Internet bill is an acceptable proof-of-address only if it is dated within the last 60 days.
facts.quote: A utility (for example, electricity, gas, water) or phone or Internet bill (with a date in the last 60 days)

facts.fact: A bank statement is an acceptable proof-of-address only if it is dated within the last 60 days.
facts.quote: A bank statement (with a date in the last 60 days)

facts.fact: The submitted government-issued photo ID must be valid and not expired.
The submitted photo ID image must be in colour, clear and well lit, and must not be a photocopy or screenshot.
facts.quote: The image is in colour, not black and white

facts.fact: Submitted document details must exactly match the payments profile info, including the organisation name if applicable.
facts.quote: Make sure that the details in the submitted documents exactly match your payments profile info, including the organisation name, if applicable.

facts.fact: The address on proof-of-address documents will not show in ad disclosures.
facts.quote: The address won't show in ad disclosure.

facts.fact: Personal data and documents submitted for verification will not be shared with any third party, per Google's data protection policy.
facts.quote: Personal data and documents won't be shared with any third party, as per the [Google data protection policy]
